findings.issue: L3 R3 says Stage accepts 1 to 20 blocks, but the stage input schema 'blocks' sets only maxItems 20 with no minItems 1. The task instructions only asked for array(20), so the schema matches the task, but it is less strict than the final L3 contract that R5 refers to.
findings.fix: Optional: add "minItems": 1 to the blocks array in stageSectionTextInputSchema, or leave the lower bound to L3's Stage validation.

findings.issue: TestDemoToolSchemasAreClosedAndBounded proves only that the schemas are closed and bounded. No test checks the specific property names, required lists or limits. A schema field that drifts from the L1-L3 contract would still pass. I checked these by reading the code; every one matches the task's schema list.
findings.fix: Optional: no change is needed for L0. The lanes' tool tests will exercise the full output shapes when they replace the stubs.

findings.issue: Security (fail-closed, FYI): requiredPermission has no case for the four demo tools, so under identity/authorization mode every demo call falls to the default branch and is denied ('tool has no permission mapping'). This is safe (deny by default) and server.go is outside this task's ownership, but the confirm tools (workiva_confirm_change_set, workiva_confirm_section_text) will need WorkivaWriteConfirm and the prepare/stage tools WorkivaWritePreview before the lanes go live.
findings.fix: Record a follow-up (or a request in docs/demo/STATUS.md) for the owner of server.go to map demo tools: prepare/stage -> PermissionWorkivaWritePreview, confirm_* -> PermissionWorkivaWriteConfirm. No change in this task.

findings.issue: Possible Duplicated Code (judgement call): the four RegisterSDK handlers share an identical shape (requireDemoDep then notImplementedYet). Acceptable because each lane replaces its handler, so extracting a shared helper now would be Speculative Generality.
findings.fix: None needed; leave as is so each lane owns its handler.

findings.issue: resultText duplicates the inline '(*mcp.TextContent)' extraction already present in audit_id_test.go, transfer_value_test.go and structured_errors_red_test.go. Existing test files may not be edited, so a new shared helper is the right call; it is also used by the lane-owned stub tests, which ties those files to demo_test.go.
findings.fix: None required. Optionally note in the lane hand-off that resultText lives in demo_test.go.

findings.issue: Deps.Facts is declared but no demo stub checks it (prepare_section only requires Recipes). Matches the task instructions; L2 will need to check Facts too when it replaces the stub.
findings.fix: None in this task; L2 should add requireDemoDep(deps.Facts != nil, "Facts") when it wires the real handler.
